_comment: Template: Export any RDF file to Excel, one sheet per rdf:type.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar rdf2xlsx --config this-file.json
_note_input: An RDF/XML (.rdf, .xml) or Turtle (.ttl) file. JSON-LD is refused.
_note_output: The .xlsx workbook to write: one sheet per type, one row per subject, one column per property.
